system.description:
When you successfully use the Negate Energy Force Power against a ranged Energy weapon (such as a blaster), you can redirect some of the shot's energy at an enemy target, in addition to the Force Power's usual benefit.

As a Free Action immediately following your successful use of the Negate Energy Force Power, choose one enemy within your line of sight, and within 6 squares of you, and make a Use the Force check against the target's Fortitude Defense.

If your Use the Force check equals or exceeds the target's Fortitude Defense, the target takes Energy damage equal to one-half of the damage you negated.
